description: Create a site and open it in Studio. Pass name to set its internal Studio/Home name (default "My Website"). Omit templateId for Swebsy's standard blank site; provide an installed template ID to import that template unchanged. Then poll swebsy_status until editorReady is true and siteId matches before editing.

name.description: Optional internal site name (trimmed). Not the SEO or public title.

templateId.description: Optional installed template ID from swebsy_list_templates. Omit for a blank site.

name: swebsy_create_site
title: Create site
